messages.subject: 1000 permutation vs multple traits/phenotypes
parts:
Hi:

With the multiple traits/phenotypes - do I need to run separate analysis for each trait using 1000 permutations each time; or I can just run the 1000 permutations ONCE and then use "pheno.col=xx" to analyze the traits one by one? Note: I'm using scantwo and the multiple imputation method.

Thank you for your time; and Happy Holidays.

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] 1000 permutation vs multple traits/phenotypes
parts:
If the phenotypes all have the same distribution, the permutation thresholds will be the same, and so you could just use any one phenotype to derive permutations.

But if there are important differences in the phenotypes' marginal distributions, there can be important differences in the significance thresholds, and so it would be safest to derive separate thresholds for each trait.

One trick that I've used in the case of gene expression phenotypes (where we had 25k genes x 6 tissues of phenotypes) was to convert each trait to normal quantiles, in which case you've forced them all to have the same marginal distribution and so you can just use permutations from a single phenotype and apply the results to all traits.

karl
